title: Getters provide a value
summary: A getter calculates a value when you read a property. You do not call it with parentheses.
introduction: A getter calculates a value when you read a property. You do not call it with parentheses. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question
